title: Coinbase Mission and Vision
description:
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

An open financial system is one that is not controlled by any one country or company (just like the internet did for distributing information). We think this is the highest leverage way to bring about more economic freedom, innovation, efficiency, and equality of opportunity in the world. We have a ten year plan to get there.

Imagine if every payment in the world was as fast, cheap, and global as sending an email.

Imagine if anyone who had an idea for a product could have customers all over the world from day one.

Imagine if anyone with a smartphone had access to the same financial services we enjoy in the developed world.

An open financial system can be a great equalizer and lift billions out of poverty while accelerating the pace of innovation around the world. This is the best way we know to change the world.

► Visit Coinbase here: https://www.coinbase.com/about

► Learn more about our mission here: https://www.coinbase.com/mission

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

► Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/coinbase
► Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/coinbase/
► Find us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coinbase/

asr.full_text: I believe that access to financial services is a basic human right. Our current financial system is broken in a lot of ways. Bank transfers are slow takes time for fiat money to move around. Today there's about 2 billion people in the world who have a cell phone, but they don't have access to financial services meaning a bank account or credit card of any kind. Crypto can make the financial services industry a fairer place. The promise of blockchain technology is that it gives control back to ordinary people. The mission of Coinbase is to create a financial system that is not controlled by any one country or company. It's decentralized. Most people find us through our first product, which is Coinbase. It's a really great app, both on the desktop and on mobile, where people can buy and sell digital currency and store it securely. Any payment in the world is as fast, cheap and global as sending an email. Before Coinbase, it wasn't easy to invest in cryptocurrencies and our mission is to be the most trusted way to buy and sell cryptocurrency. Working at Coinbase right now means you get to establish and be a part of what the next generation of the financial system could look like. The opportunity that Coinbase has in front of it is to connect the whole world, under one new financial system. We can spark economic growth in countries that have become stagnant, we can unlock a new wave of innovation, and we can empower billions of people in the world today who don't have access to financial services at all. This is something that's not only going to change the face of finance, but the way that humans and societies interact with each other. It's incredibly exciting. I am doing something that will make the world a better place. We are literally seeing the global financial markets reshape in front of our eyes, and we are at the centre of it.
